en.headline: Halloween installations light up Statue Square Gardens through end of October
en.dek: Hongkong Land’s free display at Statue Square Gardens South runs nightly until 31 October, with a family day scheduled on Chater Road this Saturday.
body: Large-scale Halloween installations remain on view at Statue Square Gardens South in Central as part of a 15-day programme organised by Hongkong Land with support from the Hong Kong Tourism Board.

The display, which began on 17 October, includes a giant eyeball sculpture over the fountain, a monumental gateway, a coffin throne and a reimagined pavilion described by organisers as a haunted jail. The installations are free to visit during the day and are lit from 4pm to 11.30pm each evening, with lighting extended until 1am on 31 October.

Chater Road hosts themed days on selected dates. A family-oriented Monster Mash Fest is scheduled for this Saturday, 24 October, with costumes, face painting and activities. The programme concludes on Halloween night with a cosplay street event.
Organisers said the installations are open to the public without booking. The broader citywide Halloween programme also includes events in other districts through the end of the month.

zh.headline: 皇后像廣場花園萬聖節裝置亮燈至月底
zh.dek: 置地公司在皇后像廣場花園南設免費裝置，每晚亮燈至10月31日，本周六遮打道將舉辦家庭日活動。
body: 中環皇后像廣場花園南的大型萬聖節裝置仍在展出，屬置地公司與香港旅遊發展局支持的一連十五日節目。
裝置自10月17日起開放，包括噴泉上的巨型眼球雕塑、大型門廊、棺材寶座，以及主辦單位稱為鬼屋的亭台重新布置。日間免費參觀，每晚四時至十一時半亮燈，31日延長至凌晨一時。
遮打道在指定日子舉辦主題活動。本周六（24日）有家庭向的Monster Mash Fest，設服裝、面部彩繪及活動。節目在萬聖節當晚以Cosplay街頭活動作結。
主辦單位表示裝置免費開放，無需預約。全市萬聖節活動亦涵蓋其他地區，持續至月底。
